theme_and_identity.description: A highly distinctive, non-generic productivity tracker dashboard web app (SaaS). Built for professionals to track routines and weekly performance. The design relies on 'Swiss Brutalism / Utility'—monochrome foundations with highly functional, intense accent colors. Avoids standard AI design slop.
theme_and_identity.theme_mode: Light mode preferred by default for maximum data clarity, utilizing off-whites and strict monochrome contrasts.

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, Lato, or Open Sans.
Always left-align text content and headings for optimum reading flow. Never center-align unless inside a strict grid module or empty state.
Headings must use tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, tiny, and have wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

colors.strategy: Structural Grayscale + Functional Accents. 95% of the UI is monochrome (bone-white, stark white, pure blacks/dark greys). Colors exist purely to guide action or indicate performance status.
colors.background: #F9F9F8 (Off-white warm tint to reduce clinical feel)
colors.surface: #FFFFFF (Pure white for actionable cards and task rows)
colors.borders: #E5E5E5 (Soft structural borders) and #0A0A0A (1px stark borders for high contrast focal points)

accents.primary_action: #002FA7 (International Klein Blue - sharp, authoritative CTA, not typical SaaS blue)
accents.success_metric: #10B981 (Emerald Green for target durasi vs aktual target hit)

layouts_and_grids.global_structure: Progressive disclosure layout. Sidebar navigation (240-280px) on the left + Main Content Area on the right.
layouts_and_grids.main_content_grid: Top area contains a dense 'Metric Strip' (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) for Ringkasan Performa (Weekly stats). The main canvas uses a strict grid layout for the CRUD task list (Daftar Tugas) and Kalender.
layouts_and_grids.bento_grid_protocol: High Density Grid (Mode B). Every pixel must be utilized. Use 'h-full' on children to ensure they stretch to match neighbors. No jagged bottoms.
layouts_and_grids.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12) for structural containers to provide breathing room. Very dense spacing inside data tables and lists (p-3, p-4).
layouts_and_grids.alignment: Strictly Left-aligned to enhance data scanability. Asymmetry over symmetry.

component_strategies.cards_and_surfaces: Grid Borders ('The Technical Look'). Expose the skeleton using 'border-collapse' style or sharp 1px borders. AVOID soft diffuse shadows entirely. Use sharp solid borders to ground elements.
component_strategies.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular edge. Must have defined interaction animations (e.g., hover:bg-black hover:text-white). NEVER use 'transition: all'.
component_strategies.forms_and_inputs: Use Shadcn Form/Input components, but HEAVILY CUSTOMIZE them to remove the 'Vercel-look'. Inputs should have sharp corners or very slight radii (rounded-sm) and stark borders.
component_strategies.data_tables: Daftar Tugas Rutin: Dense, left-aligned, highly scannable rows. Use strict bottom-borders for separation rather than enclosed cards.
component_strategies.ai_insight_card: Wawasan AI: Place prominently on the dashboard. Use 'Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant)' layered over the geometric abstract art texture, OR a striking Klein Blue background with stark white text.

visual_enhancers.motion: Use Framer Motion for smooth state changes, micro-interactions, and staggered entrance animations for the task list.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a technical, crisp aesthetic instead of standard Lucide.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlays where appropriate. Avoid glossy, generic modern SaaS aesthetics.

ai_insight_background.description: Black and white stark geometric pattern to be used as a subtle background header or mask image texture for the 'Wawasan AI' (AI Insight) card.

user_avatar.description: Professional modern portrait for the user profile section in the sidebar/header navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Review package.json. If framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, or specific Shadcn components are missing, ensure they are installed/added.
Implement the UI directly using Tailwind CSS and React/JSX.
Ensure the entire application uses Bahasa Indonesia (e.g., 'Masuk', 'Dasbor', 'Daftar Tugas', 'Kategori', 'Prioritas', 'Catatan', 'Target vs Aktual').
Follow the precise typography rules: do not use Inter. Use Cabinet Grotesk for headers and Satoshi/General Sans for body text via Next/Google fonts or font-family classes.
All interactive elements must have proper `:hover`, `:focus`, and `:active` states with accessible contrast ratios.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Dark colors look good when used independently.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='task-status-toggle').
Use `sonner` for toasts. Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions like dropdowns, calendars, or modals (Use Shadcn).
CRITICAL: Do not use completely transparent backgrounds over surfaces that have content under them (e.g., Dropdowns, Sticky headers).
